summary: Global Asset Management Group filed Form 8-K disclosing the resignation of Director Daniel Snyder effective July 24, 2026, for personal business reasons unrelated to company disputes, and the appointment of David Marshall Nissman to the Board and Audit Committee. Nissman brings legal, banking, and governance experience. The company also announced two appointments to its Corporate Advisory Board. This is a routine board transition, not a forced departure, so it is not a material special situation.
